messages:
maria-ops: Quick FYI: planning a short rolling maintenance tonight 23:30-00:50 UTC for apac-edge racks to apply microcode and reboot a subset of GPU nodes. Goal: avoid longer thermal issues we saw this week. We'll cordon/drain 2 nodes per rack, run kvseed, and validate warm cache. Expect transient p95 spikes and a ~8% capacity dip during peak of the window. Posting runbook and ops plan below.

leo-infra: Ack. Which racks and which nodes? Also any traffic steering so we don't hit eu/us unnecessarily?

maria-ops: Targets: apac-edge-rack-12 nodes 03/04, apac-edge-rack-13 nodes 01/02. Routing policy will bias to nearby apac standby then to eu if necessary. No changes to customer-visible pools.

josh-sre: tagging @ops-oncall. I'll join for the drain and monitor SLOs. Preflight checklist: KV seed script present, canary routing config updated, alert thresholds tuned.

ops-oncall: Confirmed alerts: p95 >450ms, gpu-util>88%, queue-depth>750 set. I'll stream snapshots to #inc-ops-live.

anya-mlops: We'll need a canary run after kvseed. Can you set 5% of traffic to canary model for 7 minutes? I'll run a lightweight eval (latency + token quality).

maria-ops: Affirmative. Canary model: gptx-3-small:canary-2026-03. Traffic plan: 0% -> 5% canary for 7m -> ramp to 10% for 3m -> decision.

leo-infra: Backfill capacity? Can we spawn short-lived dedicated-burst nodes in apac to reduce routing jitter? What's cost hit?

maria-ops: We'll provision 3x vgpu-2 nodes in dedicated-burst-temp for 80 minutes. Estimated cost +$375. Cost ticket CT-2026-450 created.

deploy-bot: Maintenance ticket created: INC-2026-1891. Preflight reminder set at 23:10 UTC.

josh-sre: Preflight ops notes:
1) run health check on target nodes (disk, nvlink, fan)
2) cordon & drain with graceful 90s
3) reboot and smoke test runtime
4) kvseed with primer 'apac-primer-v2'
5) run canary traffic and evaluate
6) uncordon if green

maria-ops: Commands we'll execute (copy/paste):
```
# preflight health
infractl node-health --rack apac-edge-rack-12 --nodes 03,04
# cordon and drain
infractl cordon node apac-edge-rack-12-03
infractl drain node apac-edge-rack-12-03 --grace 90
# reboot
infractl reboot node apac-edge-rack-12-03 --warm
# kvseed
infractl kvseed --node apac-edge-rack-12-03 --primer apac-primer-v2
# canary routing tweak
infractl route-set canary gptx-3-small:canary-2026-03 --pct 5
```

leo-infra: Rollback criteria: abort if p95 >600ms for 12m straight OR error-rate spikes >1.5x baseline for 10m. If aborted, immediate full reroute to eu/us and spawn 4 extra burst nodes.

ops-oncall: I'll post minute-by-minute snapshots during drain and escalate if thresholds breach. Also will annotate incidents with exact timestamps for postmortem.

anya-mlops: After canary run I'll post quick eval results (latency median/p95, sample diffs). If model quality drops, we stop and rollback.

maria-ops: I'll post a short customer note in #support and update status page if any prolonged impact. Planning to run maintenance as quiet-window operation to limit user exposure. :white_check_mark:

leo-infra: Good. Ping me if we need to shift racks or extend the window.

josh-sre: See everyone at 23:20 UTC for preflight.

deploy-bot: Reminder: preflight check at 23:10 UTC.
